notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome120), no proxy/Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. robots.txt gave HTTP 421 Misdirected Request from Cloudflare on that path only (reproduced across fresh sessions); every other endpoint including this concept's own pages returned clean 200s, so treated as an edge quirk, not a block - no Claude-specific disallow found anywhere, tiers 2/3 never needed. SALE VS CLEARANCE - THE KEY JUDGMENT: the homepage mega-nav 'Sale' tab (url /c/shop-sale) contains two clearly separate mechanisms: (1) 'Sale by Category' - a generic ?sale=1 percent-off filter applied per department (Furniture/Rugs/Lighting/etc.), tied to a site-wide countdown-timer promo banner visible on this and other pages ('Up to 50% Off Sitewide + 10% Off Orders Over $800* with code ENDOFSUMMER', with a live JS countdown clock counting down to 2026-09-09) - this is exactly the rotating, time-boxed flash-sale-event mechanism the task brief warns is core to this company's business model, so it was excluded as Sale, not Clearance; also excluded 'Up to 25% Off Vintage' (/c-101336-vintage?sale=1) for the same reason (same generic sale filter, no clearance/permanence signal). (2) A separately and distinctly labelled link, 'Up to 50% Off Clearance' -> /c-20221212-clearance, whose own page data confirms it is a standing category node (category.name='Clearance', category.page_title='Clearance', BigCommerce id 10750, breadcrumb Curations > Clearance) with no countdown/expiry timer element anywhere on the page itself (grepped for countdown/expires/ends in/sale ends/limited time/final sale/while supplies last on the fetched HTML - only the site-wide banner strip carried a countdown, not this page's own content). Cross-checked /sitemap-plp.xml (grepped clearance|outlet|final-sale|last-chance|end-of-line|discontinued) which surfaced this URL plus one additional hit, /c-20220000-clearance, a dead/retired node whose canonical resolves to /external-page with no category or product data (page_title generic 'Sale | One Kings Lane', category=null, total=null) - excluded as a stale sitemap entry, not a live listing. No 'outlet', 'final sale', 'last chance', or 'end of line' pages found anywhere in nav/sitemap. Judgment: /c-20221212-clearance is classified as genuine Clearance, not flagged, because the site's own taxonomy names it 'Clearance' via a distinct persistent category id, structurally separate from the countdown-driven 'Sale by Category' promotional mechanism used everywhere else on the site - this satisfies the brief's test that the site's OWN taxonomy (not just page copy) treats it as clearance/outlet-style merchandising. No genuine department sub-structure exists for Clearance in the mega-nav (unlike Bestsellers/New Arrivals, which do have named per-department children) - Clearance is a single undifferentiated listing on this site, so only one row is emitted, not invented as a group.
